senses.sense_definition: In a way that relates to deep inward feelings rather than to the intellect.

examples.text: The audience reacted <w>viscerally</w> to the intense and emotional performance on stage.
I felt <w>viscerally</w> connected to the story because it mirrored my own childhood experiences.

senses.sense_definition: Relating to the internal organs of the body, especially those in the abdomen.

examples.text: The surgeon examined the patient <w>viscerally</w> to determine the extent of the internal injury.
The trauma caused the patient to be <w>viscerally</w> damaged during the accident.
